title: StreamSubscribe
description: The first client message of a viewer stream opened with ?subscribe=1 (spec: "Stream format"): the signal ids to stream, sent in the message body because a long id list does not fit in the WebSocket request line. The server answers with the stream-handshake.

ids.description: The signal ids in frame order, each exactly as the run manifest lists it; an empty list streams every manifest signal in manifest order.
